requirements.statement: ARMv4T LDM without SPSR restoration ignores loaded PC bits[1:0], enters ARM state, and uses the word-aligned target.

For ARM946E-S LDM without SPSR restoration, loaded PC bit 0 selects ARM/Thumb state and the target clears bit 0 when CP15 Control bit 15 is clear; loaded bits[1:0]=10 are UNPREDICTABLE. Control bit 15 set disables loading T and selects the word-aligned ARM-state behavior.

source_refs.locator: §A4.1.20 LDM(1), ARMv5 behavior and ARM/Thumb state transfer note
§2.3.5 Control Register bit 15, Disable loading TBIT

requirements.statement: A successful S-bit LDM including R15 restores CPSR from SPSR and derives the branch state from restored SPSR.T; the loaded PC value is aligned for that restored state rather than selecting state from loaded bit 0. If restored SPSR.T is zero while loaded PC bit 1 is one, the result is UNPREDICTABLE and no constrained PC/CPSR commit intent is emitted.
A precise Data Abort suppresses the LDM PC write and SPSR-to-CPSR restoration; exception entry determines the visible PC instead.

source_refs.locator: §A2.6.6 Effects of data-aborted instructions, rules 1 and 7
